CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
March 10, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim March 2026 as Women's History Month in the City of La Mirada and present proclamations to Mary Carlson and Jenny Bae.
5.1 Proclamation Women's History Month
5.2
PROCLAMATION FOR AMERICAN RED CROSS MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim March 2026 as American Red Cross Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to American Red Cross Community Outreach Specialist Christina Sanchez.
5.2 Proclamation American Red Cross
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO YOUTH COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council appoint Sienna Dominguez to the Youth Council for a term ending in October 2026.
7.1 Appointment Youth Council
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of February 24, 2026.
8.1 City Council Minutes
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated March 10, 2026 in the total amount of $3,407,176.97.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
AMENDMENT TO SOUND ENGINEERING SERVICES AGREEMENT – It is recommended the City Council approve an amendment to the Professional Services Agreement for Sound Engineering Services with Mark Wood Entertainment, Inc. extending the agreement for one year and including the Easter Egg Hunt event for a total contract cost of $35,464 and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
8.3 Sound Engineering Svcs.
8.4
APPROVAL OF LA MIRADA ARTS COLONY “MIRRORS OF YOUR MIND” ART EXHIBIT IN THE LA MIRADA ACTIVITY CENTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the use of the La Mirada Activity Center’s Multi-Purpose Room for the La Mirada Arts Colony to host an art exhibit, and waive all fees associates with the requested use.
8.4 Arts Colony Request
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTIONS NOS. 26-06 AND 26-07 APPROVING THE EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES RESULTING FROM THE ANNEXATION OF PM 73574 TO THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES LIGHTING MAINTENANCE DISTRICT 10045A – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-06 approving the exchange of property tax revenues resulting from annexation of PM 73574 to County Lighting Maintenance District 10045A; and adopt Resolution No. 26-07 on behalf of the City of La Mirada as successor of the Southeast Recreation and Park District approving the exchange of property tax revenues resulting from annexation of PM 73574 to County Lighting Maintenance District 10045A.
9.1 Resolutions Nos. 26-06 and 26-07 Approving the Exchange
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 26-08 ADOPTING AN ENGINEERING AND TRAFFIC SURVEY JUSTIFYING SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN CITY STREETS AND FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 749 AMENDING SECTION 10.12.020 OF CHAPTER 10.12 OF TITLE 10 OF THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE ESTABLISHING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN CITY STREETS – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-08 adopting an Engineering and Traffic Survey justifying speed limits on certain City streets; and introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 749 amending Section 10.12.020 of Chapter 10.12 of Title 10 of the La Mirada Municipal Code establishing prima facie speed limits on certain City streets, by title only, and waive further reading.
9.2 Resolution No. 26-08 Adopting and Engineering and Traffic Survey Report
Ordinance No. 749 Engineering and Traffic Survey
Resolution No. 26-08
